results.name: Barbell Snatch From Blocks
instructions: Start in a squat position with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward. Place the barbell on blocks positioned at knee height. Hold the barbell with a wide overhand grip (palms facing down), hands placed wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the blocks by extending your hips and knees simultaneously, keeping the barbell close to your body.

As the barbell reaches hip level, explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles while pulling the barbell upward in one smooth motion. Quickly drop into a squat position and catch the barbell overhead with your arms fully extended.
Stand up by extending your hips and knees, keeping the barbell overhead. Lower the barbell back to the blocks with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Explode through your hips and knees to generate the power needed for the lift.
Drop quickly into the squat to catch the barbell overhead in a stable position.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
results.description: Barbell Snatch From Blocks is an advanced multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Upper Back, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Snatch Pull
instructions: Start in a squat position with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward. Hold the barbell with a wide overhand grip (palms facing down), hands placed wider than shoulder-width apart. The barbell should be on the floor, close to your shins.
Lift the barbell off the floor by extending your hips and knees simultaneously, keeping the barbell close to your body.

As the barbell reaches hip level, explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles while pulling the barbell upward. Focusing on pulling the barbell up to abdomen height by driving your elbows upward and outward.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control, bending your hips and knees. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the barbell close to your body throughout the lift to maximize efficiency and control.
Explode through your hips and knees to generate the power needed for the lift.
Focus on a strong, controlled pull to ensure proper form and muscle engagement.
results.description: Barbell Snatch Pull is an advanced multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hamstrings, Upper Back.

results.name: Barbell Snatch
instructions: Start in a squat position with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward. Hold the barbell with a wide overhand grip (palms facing down), hands placed wider than shoulder-width apart. The barbell should be on the floor, close to your shins.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles while pulling the barbell upward in one smooth motion. Keeping the barbell close to your body as you lift.
As the barbell reaches chest height, quickly drop into a squat position and catch the barbell overhead with your arms fully extended.
Stand up by extending your hips and knees, keeping the barbell overhead. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Explode through your hips and knees to generate the power needed for the lift.
Drop quickly into the squat to catch the barbell overhead in a stable position.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
results.description: Barbell Snatch is an advanced multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Upper Back, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Split Clean
instructions: Start in a squat position with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward. Hold the barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing down), hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. The barbell should be on the floor, close to your shins.
Lift the barbell off the floor by extending your hips and knees simultaneously, keeping the barbell close to your body.

As the barbell reaches hip level, explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles while pulling the barbell upward. Quickly drop into a split stance, with one foot forward and the other foot back, catching the barbell at shoulder height with your elbows pointing forward.
Stand up by bringing your feet back together, keeping the barbell at shoulder height. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the barbell close to your body throughout the lift to maximize efficiency and control.
Explode through your hips and knees to generate the power needed for the lift.
Quickly transition into the split stance to catch the barbell in a stable position.
results.description: Barbell Split Clean is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Upper Back, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Split Jerk
instructions: Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip (palms facing forward), hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Your elbows should be pointing slightly forward, and your chest should be up.
Engage your core, dip slightly by bending your knees and hips, then explosively extend your knees and hips to drive the barbell overhead.

As you drive the barbell up, quickly split your feet into a lunge position with one foot forward and the other foot back, catching the barbell overhead with your arms fully extended and your torso upright.
Stand up by bringing your feet back together, keeping the barbell overhead. Lower the barbell back to shoulder height with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use your legs to drive the barbell up by explosively extending your hips and knees.
Quickly transition into the split stance to catch the barbell in a stable position.
Maintain a neutral spine and keep your chest up throughout the movement.
results.description: Barbell Split Jerk is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Upper Back, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Thruster
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing forward), hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Position the barbell at shoulder height.
Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and hips, ensuring your thighs are just lower than your knees.
Push through your heels to extend your legs and return to a standing position. As you rise, simultaneously press the barbell overhead by extending your arms fully.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height and immediately descend into the next squat. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Drive through your heels during the squat to engage your glutes and quadriceps.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you press the barbell overhead and inhaling as you lower it back down.
Ensure a fluid transition from the squat to the overhead press to maximize efficiency.
results.description: Barbell Thruster is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Triceps.

results.name: Cluster
instructions: Begin in a squatted position with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell on the floor in front of you. Grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.

Lift the barbell to a front rack position by performing a clean movement, explosively extending your hips and knees, shrugging your shoulders, and then catching the barbell at your shoulders with your elbows pointing forward. As you catch the barbell, simultaneously lower into a squat by bending your knees and hips until your thighs are lower than your knees.
From the bottom of the squat, stand up straight by extending your knees.
Lower the barbell back to the floor. Repeat the sequence for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use a controlled and explosive movement during the clean phase to effectively lift the barbell.
Ensure a controlled descent of the barbell to the floor to prevent injury and maintain form.
Maintain a slight bend in your knees when catching the barbell in the front rack position.
results.description: Cluster is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Hang Power Clean
instructions: Begin in a squat position with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other), letting the dumbbells hang close to your shins.
Explosively extend your hips and knees, shrugging your shoulders as you pull the dumbbells upward.
As the dumbbells reach chest height, quickly rotate your wrists and elbows to catch the dumbbells on your shoulders while dropping into a partial squat.
Stand up by extending your hips and knees, bringing the dumbbells to shoulder height. Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use your hips and knees to generate power for the lift, not your lower back.
Move explosively during the upward phase and catch the dumbbells with control.
Avoid locking your knees; keep a slight bend to protect your joints.
results.description: Dumbbell Hang Power Clean is an advanced multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Upper Back, Lower Back.

results.name: Dumbbell One Arm Snatch
instructions: Start in a squat position with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell on the floor between your feet. Grasp the dumbbell with your right hand, using an overhand grip, while keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Drive through your heels and explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, pulling the dumbbell upward close to your body as you rise.
As the dumbbell reaches shoulder height, raise your hand straight up to bring the dumbbell overhead, fully extending your arm.
Stand up fully, keeping the dumbbell overhead. Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged and your back straight to maintain proper form.
Exhale during the explosive upward movement and inhale when lowering the dumbbell.
Focus on using your hips and legs to generate power, minimizing the strain on your arm and shoulder.
results.description: Dumbbell One Arm Snatch is an advanced multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Upper Back, Lower Back.

results.name: Plate Clean and Press
instructions: Grip a weight plate on the floor and hinge at your hips.
Drive your hips forward to clean the plate up to your chest.
Press the plate straight overhead until your arms are locked out.
Lower it to your chest, then to the floor, and repeat.
tips: Brace your core before the press.
Keep your back flat when lowering.
results.description: Plate Clean and Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Triceps, Traps.
